review:
Cleocatra is a feline take on Ancient Egypt with wilds carrying 2x or 3x multipliers and a 5,000x maximum win. Its respin is the base-game hook: a full stack of cat symbols on reel one makes all wilds and matching cats sticky and respins until a winning line forms.

Three, four or five scatters award 8, 12 or 16 free spins, where every wild stays sticky until the end of the round, and a full stack of cats on reel one adds two more spins. Pragmatic lists a 96.20% RTP. It suits players who like classic line slots with sticky features.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
